option_evidence.text: (* Run cubicle with options: -brab 2 -forward-depth 5                     *)

let set_tx arg =
  let  fwd, bwd, check, allow = match arg with
  | "none" ->   false, false, true,  true
  | "fwd" ->    true,  false, true,  true
  | "bwd" ->    false, true,  true,  true
  | "all" ->    true,  true,  true,  true
  | "ignore" -> false, false, false, true
  | s -> raise (Arg.Bad ("tx argument '"^s^"' must be none, fwd, bwd, all, or ignore")) in
  tx_bwd := bwd; tx_fwd := fwd; tx_allow := allow; tx_check := check

(* Check that system doesn't use transaction features. *)
let no_transactions s =
  ListLabels.iter s.trans ~f:(fun t ->
      if not t.tr_may_yield || t.tr_is_triggered || t.tr_nexts <> [] then
        error (HasTracts t.tr_name) t.tr_loc)

if Options.tx_check then
    check_triggers s
  else if not Options.tx_allow then
    no_transactions s
